scope: Original 12.60 client ABuildingFoundation streaming: static binary and reflection evidence, not runtime parity

identity.evidence: The registration references the wrapper; the wrapper calls the constructor. After its parent constructor returns, 0x141bce07e-0x141bce085 stores 0x145f0e530 at [this].

0xea8.evidence: The reflected OnRep_LevelToStream exec at 0x142740c90 dispatches through this slot.

0xeb0.evidence: The reflected OnRep_ServerStreamedInLevel exec at 0x142740cb0 dispatches through this slot.

0xec0.evidence: This base implementation directly calls the candidate-selection helper at 0x141bdd71d.

0xec8.evidence: The streaming body calls this virtual function to obtain a rotator before constructing the level transform.

identity.rejected_candidate: 0x145f23c60 is not the primary table written by the authenticated constructor.

evidence: Reflection identifies AdditionalWorlds at 0xb40 and LevelToStream at 0xba0; 0x141be6209-0x141be6346 traverses the array at 0x28-byte stride and appends candidate records.
The authenticated vtable target 0x141bdd6e0 calls 0x141be60c0 with the same this pointer at 0x141bdd71d.
A second caller invokes the helper at 0x141bd5b35, selects a candidate and writes its name to this+0xba0 at 0x141bd5b72; its conditional path then calls 0x141bed450 at 0x141bd5b90.
selection.limit: The observed path selects a candidate. It does not establish that every AdditionalWorlds entry is simultaneously streamed or establish the complete selection policy.

evidence: OnRep_LevelToStream conditionally calls 0x141bed450(this, false) at 0x141be5c1d. The body has additional role, state, world and level-name checks; the call is not unconditional.

At 0x141bedaa8 the body calls vtable slot 0xec8. The base target 0x1417e3f70 reads the root component at this+0x130 and derives a rotator from its world quaternion at component+0x1c0, using a cached conversion; the null-root fallback is zero rotation.

At 0x141bedaae-0x141bedaf4 the body reads world translation from root component+0x1d0 or a fallback vector. At 0x141bedc86-0x141bedcef it converts the rotator to a quaternion and writes streaming object offsets 0x80, 0x90 and 0xa0 as rotation, translation and scale respectively. Scale comes from root component+0x134; reflection identifies USceneComponent RelativeScale3D at offset 308 (0x134).
UE 4.25 Engine/Classes/Engine/LevelStreaming.h declares LevelTransform as the transform applied to actors after loading.
limits: The vtable call can be overridden by a derived class; the target described is the authenticated base implementation.
The scale source is relative scale while rotation and translation are world values. Copying a full world transform may differ for attached or scaled parents.
The body later dereferences the root component for scale; the earlier null-root translation fallback does not establish that the entire path is safe without a root component.
Static disassembly and captured decompilation do not establish complete streaming, replication, visibility or runtime parity.
